notes.title: v1.24 Patch
notes.content:
A small update to fix an issue brought to my attention by Moe Anthropomorphism:

You can now use the keyboard controls even if you have a game controller plugged in. 

Also I reduced the file size a bit by compressing the audio. 

Hope everyone's enjoying the game! Let me know if there's any more issues.

-Drew

tags.bug: You can now use the keyboard controls even if you have a game controller plugged in.
